K_semantics: K nonanchor direction budgets. Include shared anchor in primary cloud ONLY if legal and absolute95%noise-qualified; always report unconditional anchor baseline separately and allow explicitly flagged action fallback.
immutable_direction_order: pair1: r.02 +/-, r.05 +/-, r.10 +/-, r.15 +/-; then pair2 in the same order. Preserve all failures in slot order.

primary_online_qualification.selection: per direction select the lowest data-Phi endpoint among radius-qualified legal noise-ball candidates; no GT. All trial states retained separately.
primary_online_qualification.legacy_DeltaPhi_le2_and_DeltaPrior_le10: SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; never filter the primary cloud

uniqueness.algorithm: greedy first representative in immutable online order; anchor first; not a posterior multiplicity rule

coverage_definition: GT lies in C_epsilon=union of full-material RMS balls around actual qualified unique cloud members plus anchor. No pixel-box claim, no 576D Lebesgue volume estimate.

primary_comparison.qualification_endpoint: mean across32 parents of qualified unique nonanchor count/16; shared anchor excluded
primary_comparison.coverage_endpoint: paired parent hit difference at epsilon.075; no invented coverage noninferiority margin
primary_comparison.matched_random: report the same paired estimates against RANDOM as a secondary comparison
primary_comparison.qualification_noninferiority_role: secondary predeclared bootstrap diagnostic; not a nominal-proof claim with n32
family_of_four_confirmatory_contrasts: FIXED_Q-DYNAMIC_Q best-of-K material MSE K16 (offline capacity only)
FIXED_Q-DYNAMIC_Q standalone full-system all-attempt wall seconds K16

uncertainty.replicate_unit: parent only; directions/seeds/radii/sources are not independent replications
uncertainty.bootstrap: percentile parent-paired bootstrap; same resampled parent indices across arms and all endpoints
uncertainty.small_n_coverage: Wilson two-sided95% and exact Clopper-Pearson one-sided95% lower bound additionally reported
uncertainty.primary_joint_claim: four predeclared root contrasts at98.75% two-sided paired-parent bootstrap; yield noninferiority is secondary95% diagnostic
uncertainty.iid_parent_scope_required: population generalization conditional on the sealed fresh-parent sampling contract

probable_GT_claim.rule: only support an empirical parent-population claim P(hit)>=1-delta when exact one-sided95% binomial lower bound>=1-delta; never interpret ensemble weight as posterior confidence

actions: uniform mean of primary qualified unique cloud; anchor fallback explicitly flagged if empty
exp(-Phi) normalized on same primary qualified unique cloud; no prior/Jacobian/proposal correction; anchor fallback if empty; approximate ensemble only
geometry: connected components of epsilon-ball overlap graph
soft_occupancy: sigmoid((Re material-.75)/.02); scalar ROI mean range and descriptive pixelwise range; no joint material-box coverage

cost.include: all attempted/rejected/failed states, full RHS/LU, correction and geometry setup, anchor acquisition, I/O and all measured online work
cost.study_allocation: shared anchor/(3 arms); shared global setup/(32 parents*3 arms); group totals sum to campaign totals once
cost.standalone_deployment_allocation: each arm receives full per-parent anchor; global setup/32 per parent for each standalone arm; do not sum these repeated deployment views as research total
cost.right_censor: time/cost to first qualified alternative censored at actual spent budget if none; no successful-only timing average
cost.timing: root rotates arm order within same parent timing window; keep actual window/order metadata

gate_before_truth: all32 parents/all3 arms/all16 direction slots sealed, including failures; root-approved frozen statistics config and separate root approval after prediction seal required; no correction/selection/model change after GT access
prior_R9_failures: retain immutable original exploration/REV1/probability evidence; this is a new possibility-set objective, not a retrospective posterior success
empty_cloud_policy: all32 retained: coverage=false, nearest material error undefined/infinite right-censored; no complete-case primary contrast and no invented finite penalty; action falls back to anchor
fresh_seed_namespace: read exact runner manifest [20261030,900901] plus role101/102/103/104,parent index; no old R7 DEV reuse
